extra.probe_method: speech against a recorded corpus (see internal/agent/speech_corpus.go): short clips of real speakers from google/fleurs (CC BY 4.0) with their verified transcriptions. An ASR is told the language and transcribes the recordings; the error rate is its own. A TTS speaks the corpus's sentences and an ASR already proven on that corpus in that language hears them (speech_reference_model). Characters for non-Latin scripts, words for Latin; realtime_factor is processing seconds / audio seconds.
